title: Modality and Evidentiality
summary: Express certainty, probability, obligation, inference, and source of information with precise Brazilian Portuguese structures.

sections.heading: Degrees of certainty
sections.body: Portuguese offers many ways to grade certainty. **Com certeza** is strong, **provavelmente** is likely, **talvez** is uncertain and often triggers the subjunctive, and **deve** can mark inference.

examples.pt: Com certeza ela recebeu a mensagem.

sections.heading: Inference with dever and futuro do presente
sections.body: **Dever + infinitive** often expresses probability, not only obligation. The simple future can also express conjecture in formal or literary style.

examples.pt: Ela deve ter esquecido a reunião.

examples.en: Who could it be at this hour?

sections.heading: Reporting source and distance
sections.body: Advanced speakers mark whether information is witnessed, inferred, reported, or uncertain. This affects responsibility and tone.

examples.pt: Pelo que ouvi, a reunião foi adiada.
examples.en: From what I heard, the meeting was postponed.

examples.pt: Ao que parece, houve um erro no sistema.
examples.en: Apparently, there was an error in the system.

examples.pt: Segundo a imprensa, a proposta será votada amanhã.
examples.en: According to the press, the proposal will be voted on tomorrow.

sections.heading: Obligation and recommendation
sections.body: Different modal expressions vary in force: **ter que** is direct, **precisar** is need-based, **deveria** is advice, and **convém** is formal recommendation.

examples.en: We need to review the text.

examples.pt: Convém verificar os dados antes de publicar.
examples.en: It is advisable to check the data before publishing.

keyPoints: Modality expresses certainty, probability, obligation, permission, or advice.
Talvez often takes the subjunctive when uncertainty is real.
Dever + infinitive can mean probability as well as duty.
Reported-source expressions protect precision and tone.
Futuro do presente can express conjecture in formal style.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ele deve estar means only 'he must be obligated to be'.
commonMistakes.right: Ele deve estar often means 'he is probably'.

commonMistakes.wrong: Segundo de acordo com o jornal...
commonMistakes.right: Segundo o jornal... / De acordo com o jornal...
commonMistakes.note: Do not mix equivalent source markers.
